Class MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder
Enclosing class:
MetroOptimizer
public static final class MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for defining a provider requirement. A provider can be identified by a well-known CloudProviderType, a Fabric service profile name, or a direct service profile UUID. Providers can be marked as required (hard constraint) or preferred (soft scoring bonus).

    • label

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder label(String label)
      Sets a custom display label for this provider requirement. If not set, the label is derived from the cloud provider name or service profile name.
      Parameters:
      label - the display label for this provider
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • serviceProfileUuid

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder serviceProfileUuid(String uuid)
      Sets a specific Fabric service profile UUID to look up for metro availability. Use this when you have the exact profile UUID rather than relying on name-based matching.
      Parameters:
      uuid - the Fabric service profile UUID
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • sellerRegions

      public MetroOptimizer.ProviderBuilder sellerRegions(String... regions)
      Sets the preferred seller regions for this provider. Metros that support these specific seller regions receive a higher provider coverage score.
      Parameters:
      regions - the preferred seller region identifiers (e.g., "us-east-1", "eu-west-1")
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
